cards.caption_en: I comb my hair and look at my face in the mirror.
cards.caption_zh: 我梳着头发，看着镜子里的脸。

words.example: I look at my face in the mirror.
words.evidence: 实际面部整体。

words.example: One eye is visible beside my nose.
words.translation: 一只眼睛在鼻子旁清晰可见。
words.evidence: 实际可辨的一只眼。

words.example: My hair is behind my ear.
words.evidence: 实际露出的耳朵。

words.example: My nose is above my mouth.
words.evidence: 面部实际鼻子。

words.example: My mouth is closed.
words.evidence: 实际口部整体。

words.example: My lower lip is below my upper lip.
words.evidence: 定位实际下唇。

words.example: My chin is below my mouth.
words.evidence: 实际下巴区域。

words.example: My hair falls beside my face.
words.evidence: 实际头发。

words.example: I hold a comb beside my hair.
words.translation: 我在头发旁拿着一把梳子。
words.evidence: 实际梳齿与梳身。

cards.caption_en: I stretch my body, open my hand, and stand with both feet on the mat.
cards.caption_zh: 我舒展身体，张开手掌，双脚站在垫子上。

words.example: I stretch my body on the mat.
words.evidence: 上幅人体整体。

words.example: I stretch one arm to the side.
words.translation: 我把一只手臂向侧面伸展。
words.evidence: 实际伸出的手臂。

words.example: My hand is open.
words.evidence: 下幅完整手掌与手指。

words.example: My index finger is beside my thumb.
words.evidence: 下幅实际食指。

words.example: My thumb points away from my fingers.
words.translation: 我的拇指向外展开，与其他手指分开。
words.evidence: 实际独立拇指。

words.example: One leg is straight.
words.evidence: 上幅实际左腿。

words.example: My foot rests on the mat.
words.evidence: 下幅脚部整体。

words.example: My big toe is beside the other toes.
words.translation: 我的大脚趾在其他脚趾旁边。
words.evidence: 实际大脚趾。

cards.caption_en: Models of the heart, brain, bone, and muscle help me learn about the body.
cards.caption_zh: 心脏、大脑、骨骼和肌肉的模型，帮助我认识身体。

words.example: I turn my head toward the model.
words.evidence: 上幅实际头部。

words.example: My neck connects my head to my body.
words.translation: 我的颈部连接着头和身体。
words.evidence: 实际露出的颈部。

words.example: My shirt covers my chest.
words.evidence: 隔着衣物定位胸部区域，不声称看见内部。

words.example: My knee bends as I sit.
words.evidence: 桌下近侧弯曲膝部；衣裙遮盖上缘，框只取可见膝部。

words.example: This model represents a heart.
words.evidence: 定位心脏教学模型，不是真实内部器官。

words.example: This model represents a brain.
words.evidence: 实际脑模型。

words.example: The pale model represents a bone.
words.translation: 浅色模型表示一根骨头。
words.evidence: 实际单根骨模型。

words.example: The red model represents a muscle.
words.translation: 红色模型表示一块肌肉。
words.evidence: 实际红色肌肉教学模型。

cards.caption_en: The dentist uses models to explain my tooth and the inside of my mouth.
cards.caption_zh: 牙医用模型向我说明牙齿和口腔内部。
cards.image_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One portrait 4:5 scene-card base image, refined cool Korean Instagram editorial photography. Two stacked photographic panels of gentle dental consultation, no procedure. Upper woman in ivory blouse seated at clinic table with adult female dentist in pale coat pointing to models; her forearm skin visible. Lower close tabletop photograph: one LARGE simplified PLASTIC tooth cutaway model with white enamel and pink interior, a clearly visible fine yellow nerve representation running from pulp through root; beside it a sagittal PLASTIC head and mouth teaching model showing a distinct pink tongue and back-of-throat passage. words.example: The dentist shows me a tooth model.
words.translation: 牙医给我看一个牙齿模型。
words.evidence: 完整牙齿教学模型。

words.example: The pink part of the model represents the tongue.
words.translation: 模型的粉色部分表示舌头。
words.evidence: 口腔模型中实际可辨粉色舌部。

words.example: The passage behind the mouth represents the throat.
words.translation: 口腔后方的通道表示咽喉。
words.evidence: 模型中口腔后方通道，不把普通人像当内部可见。

words.example: The skin on my arm is visible.
words.translation: 我的手臂皮肤露在外面。
words.evidence: 上幅真实前臂皮肤。

words.example: The yellow line represents a nerve in the tooth.
words.translation: 黄色线条表示牙齿中的一条神经。
words.evidence: 仅定位牙模型黄色神经示意。

words.example: I ask for medical help with my tooth.
words.translation: 我为牙齿问题寻求医疗帮助。
words.evidence: 医疗功能由故事说明，不从白衣鉴定资质。

words.example: I tell the dentist about my tooth pain.
words.translation: 我告诉牙医我的牙痛情况。
words.evidence: 主观疼痛由句子说明，不从表情诊断。

cards.caption_en: I visit the hospital with a cough; later, I feel well again.
cards.caption_zh: 我因为咳嗽来到医院；后来，我又感觉好了。
cards.image_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One portrait 4:5 scene-card base image, refined cool Korean Instagram editorial photography. words.example: I wait at the hospital.
words.evidence: 故事设定在医院候诊；画面接待区提供地点提示，静态装修不能独立证明医院资质。

words.example: The doctor explains the disease.
words.evidence: 不从照片诊断疾病。

words.example: I feel ill and need a rest.
words.translation: 我感觉不舒服，需要休息。
words.evidence: 状态由本人句子说明。

words.example: Later, I feel healthy again.
words.translation: 后来，我又觉得身体健康了。
words.evidence: 静态外表不能证明健康。

words.example: I cough into my elbow.
words.evidence: 上幅肘弯遮口动作与句子对应，不由姿势判断病因。

words.example: I sneeze into a tissue.
words.evidence: 中幅纸巾护鼻动作与句子对应。

words.example: I feel feeble after being ill.
words.evidence: 体力是故事说明，不按外貌鉴定。

words.example: I return to my normal routine.
words.translation: 我回到正常的日常生活。
words.evidence: normal选日常状态义，不虚构检测值。

cards.caption_en: A small wound on my arm needs care, and someone is here to help.
cards.caption_zh: 手臂上的小伤口需要照料，有人正在帮我。
cards.image_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One portrait 4:5 scene-card base image, refined cool Korean Instagram editorial photography. Adult East Asian woman about 25, elegant pearl/slate everyday clothing appropriate to scene, understated natural makeup, real skin pores, credible hands and anatomy, soft cool daylight and restrained colours. Teaching objects crisp and distinct, clean spaces near outer edges for later labels. No text, letters, digits, brands, labels, captions, logos or watermarks. Non-graphic calm clinic editorial: dressed woman seated at left with forearm gently resting on table while female clinician in pale coat applies a clean small dressing, hands anatomically natural. A tiny superficial scratch with ONE pinhead-sized red dot visible near dressing, no open wound gore. A small clean gauze pad with a tiny red spot lies separately on tray so blood cue is discernible. Caring neutral expression, no surgical scene, no needles; caption will explain hypothetical operation and subjective states separately.

words.example: There is a small wound on my arm.
words.translation: 我的手臂上有一个小伤口。
words.evidence: 前臂微小红点伤口，框选这一局部，非整条手臂。

words.example: A drop of blood marks the gauze.
words.translation: 一滴血在纱布上留下痕迹。
words.evidence: 纱布上的小红点由故事说明为血，非材料检测。

words.example: The doctor says this wound does not need an operation.
words.translation: 医生说这个伤口不需要手术。
words.evidence: 包扎不冒充手术，判断仅为虚构故事台词。

words.example: I remain conscious and answer the nurse.
words.translation: 我保持清醒，回答护士的话。
words.evidence: 清醒状态由故事明确，不仅按睁眼判断。

words.example: The wound causes physical discomfort.
words.translation: 这个伤口带来身体不适。
words.evidence: physical与不适搭配，由完整句子支持。

words.example: The nurse says the injury is not serious.
words.translation: 护士说这次受伤并不严重。
words.evidence: 不用表面图进行真实伤情分级。

words.example: The nurse helps me with the dressing.
words.evidence: 实际护理协助动作的手部区域。

words.example: I feel safe while the nurse helps me.
words.translation: 护士帮助我时，我感觉安心。
words.evidence: 主观安全感由句子说明，不构成医学保证。

cards.caption_en: I take a slow breath, notice a gentle feeling, and learn about digestion.
cards.caption_zh: 我缓缓吸一口气，留意舒缓的感受，也了解消化。

words.example: I take a slow breath after the walk.
words.translation: 散步后，我缓缓吸一口气。
words.evidence: 呼吸气流不可见，由动作故事句子说明。

words.example: This model represents the stomach.
words.evidence: 实际胃教学模型，不把腹部表面当胃本体。

words.example: I learn about digestion with the model.
words.evidence: 过程不可由静态模型直接看见。

words.example: My sense of smell helps me notice the herb.
words.evidence: 感官功能由自然例句说明，不框植物代替感官。

words.example: I have a feeling of calm after resting.
words.evidence: 主观感受不从静态表情断定。

words.example: I feel well after a rest.
words.translation: 休息后我感觉身体很好。
words.evidence: well选健康状态形容词义，故事自述。

cards.caption_en: I run, jump, and kick the ball; my friend joins the match.
cards.caption_zh: 我跑动、跳起、踢球；朋友也加入了比赛。

words.example: The ball is beside my foot.
words.evidence: 下幅独立足球。

words.example: I kick the ball toward my friend.
words.evidence: 下幅踢球动作姿势和球的关系。

words.example: I jump above the grass.
words.evidence: 中幅双脚离地的实际姿势。

words.example: I run across the field.
words.evidence: 上幅跑步步态与句子对应。

words.example: My legs are in motion as I run.
words.evidence: 跑动中的腿部区域，连续过程由句子支持。

words.example: I move toward the ball.
words.evidence: 上幅运动身体指代，方向由句子解释。

words.example: I stretch my leg to kick the ball.
words.evidence: 下幅实际伸出的腿。

words.example: My legs feel strong after practice.
words.translation: 练习后，我感觉双腿很有力量。
words.evidence: 体力不能从姿势直接测定。

words.example: Let my friend join the match.
words.evidence: 允许关系由明确句子支持。

words.example: We enjoy a friendly competition.
words.translation: 我们享受一场友好的竞赛。
words.evidence: 竞赛规则由故事说明，不按多人画面认定正式赛事。

words.example: My friend joins the football match.
words.translation: 我的朋友加入这场足球比赛。
words.evidence: 比赛身份由句子说明。

cards.caption_en: I swim toward the rail, then hold it as I step out.
cards.caption_zh: 我游向扶手，然后扶着它走出泳池。

words.example: I swim toward the edge of the pool.
words.evidence: 上幅水中游泳姿态，运动由句子支持。

words.example: I keep my balance as I step out.
words.translation: 走出泳池时，我保持平衡。
words.evidence: 下幅扶栏落脚的平衡姿态，不声称测得稳定性。

words.example: I keep a firm grip on the rail.
words.evidence: 实际环握栏杆的手部。

words.example: The metal support steadies the rail.
words.evidence: 实际栏杆支撑部件。

words.example: I hold the rail so I do not fall.
words.evidence: 否定预防句，画面没有跌倒，不编造动作框。

words.example: I step carefully so I do not slip.
words.evidence: 画面没有滑倒，使用完整否定语境。

words.example: I pull myself closer to the rail.
words.evidence: 握持与拉近的句子指代手臂，不声称从静态图测得力向。

words.example: I push against the rail as I stand.
words.evidence: 实际撑扶手姿态，力向由句子说明。

cards.caption_en: I smile with a friend, laugh at a joke, and cry during a film.
cards.caption_zh: 我和朋友微笑，听笑话时大笑，看电影时落泪。
cards.image_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One portrait 4:5 scene-card base image, refined cool Korean Instagram editorial photography. words.example: I smile at my friend.
words.evidence: 上幅实际微笑口部。

words.example: I laugh at a joke.
words.evidence: 中幅张口笑的面部姿态。

words.example: I cry during a sad film.
words.translation: 我看悲伤的电影时哭了。
words.evidence: 下幅实际泪痕与哭泣姿势。

words.example: I feel sad about the story.
words.translation: 我为这个故事感到难过。
words.evidence: 主观情绪由自述，不凭面容诊断。

words.example: I feel angry when someone is unkind.
words.translation: 有人不友善时，我会生气。
words.evidence: 故事情境，不用未呈现表情冒充证据。

words.example: A loud noise gives me a feeling of fear.
words.translation: 一声巨响让我感到害怕。
words.evidence: 情绪与声音由句子说明。

words.example: The unexpected news is a shock to me.
words.translation: 这条意外消息让我震惊。
words.evidence: shock选心理震惊义，不涉及医学休克。

words.example: My friend brings me a pleasant surprise.
words.translation: 朋友给我带来一个惊喜。
words.evidence: 情节由句子支持。

lexical_review: Codex按本卡语境编辑复核。未声称访问词典全文；器官使用教学模型，健康状态与治疗判断仅为虚构词汇例句，不提供个人医疗建议。
